The sparkline is NOT its own BEM block: it emits `<svg class="pa-kpi-tile__spark">`, which is an ELEMENT of the `pa-kpi-tile` block. So `block` here is `pa-kpi-tile__spark` — a VACUOUS reverse-check (no `pa-kpi-tile__spark--*` modifiers and no `pa-kpi-tile__spark__*` sub-elements exist), but the base element class `.pa-kpi-tile__spark` DOES exist in main.css, so no vacuous-scope note fires. The trailing-dot path (`dot_at={{cx,cy}}` → a `<circle>` the JS hook swaps for a `.pa-kpi-spark-dot` span) is DEFERRED prose: `dot_at` is a `{cx,cy}` TUPLE the generic string/bool/enum dumper path cannot express, and `<circle>` is a NATIVE tag with no pa-* class, so skipping it leaves no `pa-kpi-tile__spark*` blind spot. `<polyline>`/`<circle>` are native. This fixture confirms ONLY what the <svg> wrapper emits: the `pa-kpi-tile__spark` class + the `viewBox` / `preserveAspectRatio` attributes + the native `<polyline points>`.
